verdict.rationale: Goodwin's Founders Workbench offers web tools such as Document Driver that handle user-entered data, so a buyer could fairly ask about an AI-training opt-out. The evidence pack contains no documentation of any AI-training data policy or opt-out control. The Data, Privacy & Cybersecurity page describes a legal advisory practice for clients, not a product control over the user's own data, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
